text:
maria: FYI — azura-6b-int4 qbringup failing our golden set (safety/code clusters). link: https://redwood.internal/evals/BR-823
maria: Key deltas: P@1 down 6%, hallucination spike on 3 code prompts. Not customer-facing yet but blocks GA for this quant config. Need promptset enrichment + labeler passes.

alex: Can you paste the failing eval sample ids?

maria: sure, repro cmd:
```
./eval_harness run --model azura-6b-int4 --golden /goldens/azura_int4_2026.jsonl --output /tmp/azura_int4_fail.json
cat /tmp/azura_int4_fail.json | jq '.failed[:8] | .[] | {id, prompt_type, metric_delta}'
```
maria: top fail ids: 14932, 14998, 15001 — mostly 'multi-turn code', 'safety-refusal', 'legal-disclaimer'

jin: Label ops can take this. Capacity: 180/day if we give CSV with `prompt_id,variant,cue` headers. ETA to finish 150 samples ~ 1 day + QC pass.

lena: ML: quick experiment ideas:
- try int3 profile (qconfig=q-int3-lowb) — sometimes reduces halluc. 
- enable prefix-kv cache (kv_cache=true) and disable aggressive dequant in kernel
We can run A/B with 100-sample microcanary.

maria: Good — let's do both: (A) promptset enrichment + label pass, (B) int3 microcanary with kv-cache. If int3 fixes, we can consider ship or re-eval quant knobs.

sam: Product: how blocking? timeline?

maria: blocking for azura-6b-int4 GA. Targeting next-weekship; need labeling + microcanary by EOD tomorrow to stay on track.

curation-bot: ticket created: RED-4123 — 'azura int4 golden regression: promptset enrichment & microcanary' (assignee: @jin)

jin: assigned. I'll create the CSV template in /shared/curation/RED-4123/ and ping labelers.

alex: I'll queue the microcanary on k8s cluster `eval-small` and post run link when done.

lena: I'll add the int3 run to the experiment matrix and hook results to dashboards.

maria: action items:
- jin: deliver 150 enriched + labeled samples (schema + examples)
- alex: run int3 & int4 microcanaries (100 samples each)
- lena: collect metrics + diff on P@1/halluc
- sam: block/priority

lena: noted

jin: will upload CSV by 10:00 PDT tomorrow

alex: ETA for microcanary results ~ 6h after run

sam: ok, ping me if risk to GA increases :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all :pray:
